name: Beko
legalEntityNote: Beko is a consumer appliance brand and the global corporate identity used by the appliance group whose current regulatory and legal records continue to name the listed entity Arçelik A.Ş. Beko B.V., Beko Europe B.V. and country subsidiaries are distinct legal entities with separate ownership, operating, sales, manufacturing or warranty roles.

ownership.summary: Beko is a consumer appliance brand and the global corporate identity used by the group whose listed legal entity remains Arçelik A.Ş. Wholly owned Beko B.V. completed the acquisition of Whirlpool Corporation's remaining 25% stake in Beko Europe in June 2026 and now owns Beko Europe 100%. Beko Europe continues to use the Whirlpool brand under a licence limited to specified jurisdictions; that licence is not global Whirlpool ownership.
ownership.parentCompany: Arçelik A.Ş., within the Koç Group

productPortfolio.name: Major home appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Beko offers refrigeration, laundry, cooking and dishwashing products across broad international markets.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify country assortment, energy label, installation, origin, importer, parts and warranty for each model.

productPortfolio.name: Small domestic appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Regional portfolios include food preparation, beverage, ironing and other household appliances.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Check whether the exact model is a group-manufactured, joint-venture, licensed or supplier-produced program.

productPortfolio.name: Floorcare and home cleaning
productPortfolio.positioning: Official country sites list cordless, canister, wet-and-dry and robot vacuum products in selected markets.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm local app region, radio approval, consumables, battery service and warranty; availability is not universal.

productPortfolio.name: Regional owned and licensed brand portfolio
productPortfolio.positioning: Beko's group portfolio includes owned, licensed and joint-venture brands, while Beko Europe uses Whirlpool in specified jurisdictions.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Do not convert a portfolio list into one ownership or manufacturing conclusion; read each licence note and legal entity.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Beko reports 38 production facilities across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Middle East.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Require the exact SKU factory and origin rather than assigning a product to the nearest group plant.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Beko Europe reports 11 production sites in Italy, Poland, Romania and Slovakia.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Identify whether the model is Beko, licensed Whirlpool or another portfolio program and obtain its plant declaration.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Official Beko manuals and country pages identify regional product ranges and local responsibility details.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the manual, rating label, declaration and warranty to the same model and destination country.

marketsChannels.evidence: Beko reports subsidiaries in more than 55 countries and consumer-brand presence in more than 100 countries.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Identify the local seller, importer, authorized distributor and service company rather than contracting with a brand name.

marketsChannels.evidence: Beko Europe operates a European multi-brand sales and distribution platform that includes owned and licensed brands.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm brand, territory and channel authorization for Beko and any licensed Whirlpool products separately.

marketsChannels.evidence: Beko floorcare availability varies materially by country site.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify destination-market listing, consumables, app support, repair capability and warranty before cross-border sourcing.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Beko combines European scale, a broad global brand portfolio and a localized manufacturing network. Its strength is breadth; its buyer risk is conflating Beko the consumer brand, Beko the corporate identity, Arçelik A.Ş., Beko Europe and licensed Whirlpool rights.
